name: Sales Payment
query:
/* Today's Sales & Receipts summary (includes returns subtraction + Journal Entries)
   Assumptions: "2025-10-01" = report date; replace with explicit date if needed.
*/

WITH
  cash_accounts AS (
    SELECT name FROM `tabAccount` WHERE account_type IN ('Bank','Cash')
  ),
  income_accounts AS (
    SELECT name FROM `tabAccount` WHERE account_type = 'Income'
  ),
  sales_totals AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN -si.base_grand_total ELSE si.base_grand_total END),0) AS sales_invoices_net
    FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
    WHERE si.docstatus = 1
      AND si.posting_date = '2025-10-01'
  ),
  je_sales AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(SUM(jea.credit),0) AS je_credit_income
    FROM `tabJournal Entry` je
    JOIN `tabJournal Entry Account` jea ON jea.parent = je.name
    WHERE je.docstatus = 1
      AND je.posting_date = '2025-10-01'
      AND jea.party_type = 'Customer'
      AND jea.account IN (SELECT name FROM income_accounts)
  ),
  pe_totals AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(SUM(pe.received_amount),0) AS total_pe_receipts_posted_today
    FROM `tabPayment Entry` pe
    WHERE pe.docstatus = 1
      AND pe.posting_date = '2025-10-01'
      AND pe.payment_type = 'Receive'
  ),
  pe_applied AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.posting_date = '2025-10-01' THEN per.allocated_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS pe_alloc_to_today_invoices,
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.posting_date < '2025-10-01' THEN per.allocated_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS pe_alloc_to_prev_invoices,
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (pe.mode_of_payment = 'Cash' OR s.is_pos = 1) AND s.posting_date = '2025-10-01' THEN per.allocated_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS pe_cash_alloc_to_today_invoices,
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (pe.mode_of_payment = 'Cash' OR s.is_pos = 1) AND s.posting_date = '2025-10-01' THEN per.allocated_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS pe_noncash_alloc_to_today_invoices
    FROM `tabPayment Entry` pe
    JOIN `tabPayment Entry Reference` per ON per.parent = pe.name
    JOIN `tabSales Invoice` s ON per.reference_name = s.name AND per.reference_doctype = 'Sales Invoice'
    WHERE pe.docstatus = 1
      AND pe.posting_date = '2025-10-01'
  ),
  je_receipts AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(SUM(jea.credit),0) AS je_total_cashcredits,
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN jea.against_voucher IS NOT NULL AND jea.against_voucher_doctype = 'Sales Invoice' AND s2.posting_date = '2025-10-01' THEN jea.credit ELSE 0 END),0) AS je_alloc_to_today_invoices,
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN jea.against_voucher IS NOT NULL AND jea.against_voucher_doctype = 'Sales Invoice' AND s2.posting_date < '2025-10-01' THEN jea.credit ELSE 0 END),0) AS je_alloc_to_prev_invoices
    FROM `tabJournal Entry` je
    JOIN `tabJournal Entry Account` jea ON jea.parent = je.name
    LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice` s2 ON jea.against_voucher = s2.name AND jea.against_voucher_doctype = 'Sales Invoice'
    WHERE je.docstatus = 1
      AND je.posting_date = '2025-10-01'
      AND jea.party_type = 'Customer'
      AND jea.account IN (SELECT name FROM cash_accounts)
  )
SELECT
  st.sales_invoices_net + COALESCE(js.je_credit_income,0) AS total_sales_today_incl_je_sales,
  COALESCE(peap.pe_cash_alloc_to_today_invoices,0) + COALESCE(jr.je_alloc_to_today_invoices,0) AS cash_collected_against_today_sales,
  COALESCE(peap.pe_noncash_alloc_to_today_invoices,0) AS noncash_collected_against_today_sales,
  (st.sales_invoices_net + COALESCE(js.je_credit_income,0)) 
    - (COALESCE(peap.pe_alloc_to_today_invoices,0) + COALESCE(jr.je_alloc_to_today_invoices,0)) AS unpaid_amount_of_today_sales,
  COALESCE(pt.total_pe_receipts_posted_today,0) + COALESCE(jr.je_total_cashcredits,0) AS total_receipts_posted_today,
  COALESCE(peap.pe_alloc_to_today_invoices,0) + COALESCE(jr.je_alloc_to_today_invoices,0) AS receipts_posted_today_for_todays_sales,
  COALESCE(peap.pe_alloc_to_prev_invoices,0) + COALESCE(jr.je_alloc_to_prev_invoices,0) AS receipts_posted_today_for_previous_sales
FROM sales_totals st
CROSS JOIN je_sales js
CROSS JOIN pe_totals pt
CROSS JOIN pe_applied peap
CROSS JOIN je_receipts jr
